title: 每日 X 精华引用榜

items.reason: Perplexity CEO 点名转发纳德拉：单向学习与蒸馏限制会让价值向模型基建方收敛，企业必须掌控自己的 learning loop。
items.reasonEn: Perplexity’s CEO elevates Nadella’s core IP thesis: one-way learning and distillation rules concentrate value; firms must own their learning loops.

items.reason: 前 OpenAI 高管一句「失败才是护城河」，把纳德拉文章改写成：可沉淀的试错过程才是比上下文更硬的资产。
items.reasonEn: Ex-OpenAI VP reframes Nadella: ‘Our failures are our moat’—messy trial-and-error compounded into owned weights beats tokens-in-context alone.

items.reason: 把大模型比作 know-how 黑洞：每次纠错都是人力资本→token 资本的转移，真正 IP 在 traces 而非文档。
items.reasonEn: Best long-form riff on Nadella: models as black holes for know-how; every correction is human capital becoming token capital in someone else’s loop.

items.reason: 工程圈大V点破 Claude 延期真相：若无 GPT-5.6 竞争，Anthropic 多半会收回 Fable 再加价。
items.reasonEn: Pragmatic Engineer dunk: Fable extensions exist only because GPT-5.6 competition makes Anthropic unable to claw back access and charge more.

items.reason: 一句「Anthropic 重置限额 / Tibo 直接取消限额」把 OpenAI 限流大战做成病毒级对比 dunk。
items.reasonEn: Viral one-liner dunking the rate-limit war: Anthropic resets usage; OpenAI’s Tibo removes the limit entirely.

items.reason: 付费用户公开信：模型再强，周更的条款也摧毁商业信任，最终把日常负载交给 Codex。
items.reasonEn: Champion-turned-critic open letter: shifting weekly usage terms destroy trust; brilliance loses to Codex as the reliable daily driver.

items.reason: 中文圈刀法总结纳德拉长文：别信任何一家大模型，但可以信微软替你管所有模型。
items.reasonEn: Chinese-tech one-liner that out-frames Nadella’s essay: trust no single model lab—trust Microsoft to orchestrate them all.

items.reason: 把 AI 落地阻力从算力改写成组织悖论：成功公司为何要自用 AI 去孕育取代自己的原生对手？
items.reasonEn: Chinese reframing of Nadella: the blocker isn’t compute—it’s why incumbents would adopt AI that enables AI-native replacements.

items.reason: 中文投资向解读：企业护城河从 Data 升级为 learning loop，模型可换、老员工经验不可被供应商带走。
items.reasonEn: CN investor unpack: real alpha is the firm’s private learning loop; Claude/GPT/Grok are swappable vendors, not the moat.

items.reason: 把取消限流比作「百亿补贴」抢用户，反问补贴退潮后谁还用得起——中文圈尖锐价格战质疑。
items.reasonEn: Chinese dunk frames limit-lifts as ‘hundred-billion subsidies’: when the free usage war ends, can users still afford AI?

items.reason: 官方账号一锤定音技术升级：tinygrad 连驱动都不要，NVIDIA/AMD 直接 map PCIe BAR。
items.reasonEn: tinygrad one-ups kernel ioctl lore: no drivers at all—maps PCIe BARs raw on both NVIDIA and AMD.

items.reason: 引用 Yahoo 披露后重框叙事：特朗普个人加密收入碾压美国所有上市加密公司，矛头对准「为谁而战」。
items.reasonEn: Warren quote-reframes Yahoo’s Trump-as-top-crypto-earner scoop into a who-is-he-fighting-for attack amid affordability politics.
